pages.title: Website pages
pages.subtitle: The six pages of the shop: About us, FAQ, delivery policy, return policy, privacy policy and terms. Write them in English and Bengali, then publish. A page that is not published does not exist for customers.
pages.readOnly: You can look at the pages but not change them. Ask an administrator for the page edit permission.

editor.readOnly: You can read this page but not change it. Ask an administrator for the page edit permission.
editor.title: Page title
editor.bodyHint: Markdown: # heading, **bold**, *italic*, - list, 1. numbered list, [link text](https://example.com). Raw HTML is not allowed.
editor.bodyHintBn: Optional. When empty, customers who read Bengali see the English text.
editor.metaTitleHint: Shown in the browser tab and in search results. Leave empty to use the page title.
editor.metaDescriptionHint: One or two sentences for search results.
editor.tooLong: Too long. The most allowed is {max} characters.
editor.previewHint: This is how the text will look on the shop. It updates as you type and shows what is typed here, saved or not.
editor.previewFallback: The Bengali text is empty, so customers who read Bengali will see the English text.
editor.previewEmpty: Nothing to show yet. Write the page text above.
editor.published: Page published. Customers can read it now.
editor.unpublished: Page unpublished. Customers can no longer open it.
editor.publishNeeds: To publish, save an English title and English text first.
editor.saveBeforePublish: Save your changes before publishing or unpublishing.
editor.publishBody: Customers will be able to open this page at {path} and it will be linked in the footer of the shop. Publish only when the text is ready to be read.
editor.unpublishBody: The page at {path} stops working at once and its footer link disappears. Customers who open it see a "not available" message. The text stays saved here.

brand.title: Brand details
brand.subtitle: What the shop shows about the business in the footer and contact places. Anything left empty is simply not shown.
brand.readOnly: You can look at the brand details but not change them. Ask an administrator for the brand edit permission.
brand.logoNote: Uploading a logo is a later step. The saved file name is kept as it is when you save here.
brand.phoneHint: A shop line or mobile. Digits, spaces and + - ( ).
brand.whatsAppHint: A mobile number such as 01712345678. It is saved as +8801712345678.
brand.hoursHint: For example: Saturday to Thursday, 10 am to 8 pm.
brand.mapHint: Latitude and longitude of the shop, both or none. Decimal degrees, for example 23.8103 and 90.4125.

errors.tooLong: Too long. The most allowed is {max} characters.
errors.phone: Use 6 to 20 digits, spaces and + - ( ) only.
errors.email: Enter an e-mail address such as name@example.com.
errors.coordinate: Enter a number in decimal degrees (latitude -90 to 90, longitude -180 to 180).
errors.pair: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.

social.title: Social links
social.subtitle: The social pages shown in the footer of the shop. Only links that are switched on appear, and only with an https address.
social.readOnly: You can look at the links but not change them. Ask an administrator for the social links permission.
social.urlHint: The full address, starting with https://, for example https://facebook.com/yourpage.
social.whatsAppHint: Either an https address or a mobile number such as 01712345678 (saved as a wa.me link).
social.removeBody: The link is deleted and disappears from the shop. You can add it again later.

errors.https: The address must start with https://, not http://.
errors.invalid: Enter a full address starting with https:// and a website name such as facebook.com.

badges.title: Trust badges
badges.subtitle: Four short lines shown in a row on the home page, for example about safe payment or delivery. Write your own wording; a badge appears only when it is switched on and has text.
badges.readOnly: You can look at the badges but not change them. Ask an administrator for the badge permission.

meaning.support-hours: About when customers can reach you.

errors.tooLong: Too long. The most allowed is {max} characters.
errors.needEnglish: Write the English text before switching this badge on.

errors.CONTENT_NOT_FOUND: This page or item was not found.
errors.CONTENT_INVALID: Some of the text is not allowed. Check the fields below.
errors.CONTENT_BODY_UNSAFE: The page text contains something that is not allowed (raw HTML tags or a link starting with javascript:). Nothing was saved. Remove it and use markdown instead.
errors.CONTENT_PAGE_INCOMPLETE: The page cannot be published yet. It needs an English title and English text.
errors.CONTENT_URL_INVALID: That address is not allowed. Use a full https:// address.

public.notAvailableTitle: This page is not available yet
public.notAvailableBody: We are still preparing this page. Please check again later.
